cc:Work.dc:title: Recorded utility contrasts
cc:Work.dc:description: Figure 2. Recorded averaged four-draw utility contrasts on the same 50 questions. Panel A compares the original combined Ridge learner with a baseline selected within training from accept, escalate, and confidence. Panel B compares three families selected within training with the four-draw confidence policy; the other individual policy results remain in Table 3. Bars are the recorded conditional 90% whole-question bootstrap intervals with fits and actions fixed. They omit refitting and research-selection uncertainty and do not provide joint coverage. Different comparators and reused data prevent a pooled effect or common causal interpretation. All displayed progression screens failed.
